news.headline: Grynspan narrowly leads informal UN secretary‑general poll
news.body: An informal United Nations Security Council straw poll placed former Costa Rican vice‑president Rebeca Grynspan as the narrow frontrunner to become the next UN secretary‑general. The result increases momentum ahead of further closed‑door votes to select a successor to António Guterres, whose term ends in December 2026.
